fact: On 16 August 2023 the steering committee for Burkina Faso's unique electronic identifier met in Ouagadougou, saying health, education, social safety nets and firms would rely on it to identify and authenticate beneficiaries and customers.
title: Burkina Faso : bientôt un identifiant unique électronique des personnes
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances
